newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB opens Thailand foreign currency bank.
newsitem.headline: NAB opens Thailand foreign currency bank.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Thursday it had opened a Bangkok International Banking Facility (BIBF) branch in Thailand.
The BIBF licence allows foreign and local banks to raise deposits offshore and lend offshore and in Thailand with all BIBF loan and deposit transactions must be in foreign currency, NAB said.

NAB's group general manager Bob Prowse said in a statement the BIBF would facilitate two-way trade and investment flows among the banking group's customer base in Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Ireland and the USA.
NAB first opened an office in Thailand in 1985 and is the first Australian bank licensed to operate an offshore banking unit branch in Thailand, NAB said.
